A generous max_image_size accommodates a small data-URI image without warnings

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{"extract_images":true,"max_image_size":10485760}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<p>Image: <img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==" alt="pixel"></p>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
